title: Foxconn says it will work with Intel to jointly develop and deploy next-gen AI infrastructure, including server racks with Intel Xeon processors and AI chips (Wen-Yee Lee/Reuters)
summary: Wen-Yee Lee / Reuters: Foxconn says it will work with Intel to jointly develop and deploy next-gen AI infrastructure, including server racks with Intel Xeon processors and AI chips — Foxconn (2317.TW) said on Thursday it will work with U.S. chipmaker Intel (INTC.O) to jointly develop and deploy next-generation AI infrastructure …
